notes.title: Drone added!!
notes.content:
Hi all,
It has been a while since last update and it was silent update but this time around I have added a new feature. Drone as title says is added to the game, you can access it at "Replay View" you can fly freely while the ghost race takes place and look anywhere you like, also you can save your flight to later send to your friend but you can also load the same drone replay with other tracks and ghost races, this is like that so that you can use your smooth perfect fly-around-track recording in any track and ghost race you have, definetly needed in the game as suggested by a friend, thanks Baldi!!.

In addition to the drone being added I have also fixed the resolution issue that was pointed before, in all resolutions now it will display correctly, sorry it took this long to fix, several things kept me away from fixing this issue.

Addiitonally some people was using W mistakenly as many games use that to accelerate but since we use drift and it requires to accelerate and brake while holding direction seems odd to have 3 fingers in so small space, well the thing is W was causing issues as its the respawn key and it was not meant to be pressed in the first millisecond of race as people was doing, now its fixed and even if you hold from start it wont make your car respawn in other dimmension, it will respawn however when its needed and pressed while you are in the race of course.

Last but not least it has been polished to increase performance in many modes, replay mode and maybe other modes as well, now all should run smoother. Please feel free to suggest anything you like to see in the game =)

I hope you enjoy the new update and use the Drone a lot =)

Bye!!!
